placement: After The Exile, before Life of Christ

events.title: The return with Zorobabel
events.summary: The returning people came with Zorobabel; he and Jesus the son of Josedec made ready the altar.

date.text: No absolute date stated for the return

events.reviewNote: The rebuilding is dated to the second year and second month after coming to the temple (1 Esdras 5:56); do not date the return itself from that statement. This return overlaps The Exile. Esdras’s later return (1 Esdras 8:1–3) must be a separate event. No verified class excerpt selected yet.

events.title: Alexander and the Greek kingdom
events.summary: Alexander, son of Philip, smote Darius and reigned over Greece; his servants bore rule after his death.

date.text: No absolute date stated in the cited passage

events.reviewNote: The passage gives a reign length, not a BCE year. No calendar conversion proposed.

events.title: The desolation of the altar
events.summary: The abomination of desolation was set upon the altar, and idol altars were built throughout the cities of Juda.
events.reviewNote: Day precision applies to the source calendar only. The sacrifice on the idol altar is the 25th, not the 15th.

events.title: Mattathias at Modin
events.summary: Mattathias refused to forsake the law and called those zealous of the law to follow him.

date.text: In those days; no absolute date stated

events.reviewNote: Sequence follows the narrative; do not assign a year from a neighbouring event.

events.title: The cleansing and dedication of the sanctuary
events.summary: Judas and his brethren went to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary; the congregation ordained eight days of dedication each year.
events.reviewNote: No BCE conversion; the class recording’s upload date and teacher are not supplied in the corpus.
